description: Source code for the TLC59108 I2C LED driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing LED control functions such as on, off, blink, and brightness settings.

methods.name: tlc59108_set_ledout
methods.description: Sets the output mode for a specific LED (off, on, PWM, group PWM).

methods.name: tlc59108_led_blink
methods.description: Configures blinking for a specific LED with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: tlc59108_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level for a specific LED.

methods.name: tlc59108_led_init
methods.description: Initializes the LED driver, sets default parameters, and wakes up the device.
